Frequent ChatGPT users who use the service to quickly search for images can now take advantage of a brand-new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Let's take a look at how it actually works.

ChatGPT makes it more convenient to add photos to conversations

Although the Visual Intelligence feature on iOS has been available for nearly two years, it currently only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in all regions.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar image searches, adding a photo in the past required tapping the "+" button, then tapping "Photos," and then selecting an image from the album.

Although the process isn't overly complicated, OpenAI rolled out a practical gesture this week that allows users to add recent photos to conversations more quickly.

OpenAI's Adam Fry said on X that users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the input box to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can then choose a photo to add to the conversation, ask questions about the photo, or use the photo as part of a prompt.

This new gesture was unveiled alongside other ChatGPT updates released this week, including more accurate recognition of the current time, faster loading and execution of lengthy conversations on the web, and clearer on-screen prompts displayed while users wait for a network connection.

Do you use AI to search for images? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
